exercises.title: Nói: long turn theo khung 4 phần
exercises.instruction: Chỉ 30 giây chuẩn bị (ghi từ khoá), rồi ghi âm nói liên tục ít nhất 75 giây theo đủ 4 phần. AI chấm theo 4 tiêu chí.

items.prompt: Describe a friend you have known for a long time. You should say: who this person is · how you met · what you usually do together. And explain why this friendship matters to you.

targetStructures: I'd like to talk about…, who…
First of all,… / What I remember most is…
The reason I chose this is that… → Overall,…
checklist: Nói đủ 75 giây, không dừng quá 3 giây
Mở đầu bằng "I'd like to talk about…" hoặc tương đương (KHÔNG "I want to talk about")
Có ít nhất 3 chi tiết cụ thể (tên / thời gian / nơi chốn)
Có phần WHY IT IS SPECIAL rõ ràng
Có câu kết, không tắt lịm giữa chừng
commonErrors: Trả lời lần lượt 4 gạch đầu dòng như trả bài, mỗi ý một câu rồi hết
Dừng ở 40–50 giây vì "hết ý" — thiếu phần WHY IT IS SPECIAL
Đọc lại nguyên văn câu chuẩn bị
Kết bằng "that's all"
rubric.sampleAnswer: I'd like to talk about my cousin Linh, who is probably the person I enjoy spending time with the most. She's two years older than me and we grew up in the same neighbourhood. What I remember most is that she never checks her phone when we're talking — which sounds like a small thing, but it makes you feel genuinely listened to. Last month I was stressed about an exam and she sat with me for almost three hours, just listening. The reason I chose Linh is that she's one of the very few people I can be completely honest with; I don't have to pretend I'm doing fine. Overall, she's more of a sister than a cousin to me, and I feel lucky to have someone like that so close by.

exercises.title: Nói: từ 6 từ khoá thành 90 giây
exercises.instruction: 30 giây ghi chú CHỈ từ khoá (tối đa 8), rồi ghi âm nói 90 giây phát triển từ đúng trang ghi chú đó. Liếc giấy tối đa 3 lần.

items.prompt: Describe a building you often see or visit. You should say: where it is · what it looks like · how it is used. And explain how you feel about it.
Describe a place you often go to in your free time.

targetStructures: which is located… / a five-minute walk from…
The moment you walk in, you…
It has become a sort of…
checklist: Ghi chú chỉ có từ khoá, không có câu hoàn chỉnh; không quá 8 từ khoá
Nói đủ 90 giây, liếc giấy không quá 3 lần
Có ít nhất 1 chi tiết giác quan (mùi / âm thanh / ánh sáng)
Mở rộng ít nhất 3 danh từ (thêm tính từ + vị trí + chi tiết)
Có câu kết
commonErrors: Ghi thành câu → đọc lại y nguyên
Ghi quá nhiều (15–20 từ) → mạch nói đứt
Sáu câu đơn rời rạc, mỗi câu một danh từ trần
Ghi bằng tiếng Việt rồi vừa nói vừa dịch
rubric.sampleAnswer: I'd like to talk about a small café on Nguyen Hue Street, which is only about a five-minute walk from my house. It's quite a modest place — dark wooden furniture, maybe eight tables, and they play old jazz records rather than pop music. The moment you walk in, the smell of roasted coffee hits you, and somehow the noise of the street just disappears. I usually go there on Sunday mornings and stay for about three hours studying — I get more done there than in a whole day at home. What makes it special is the owner, an elderly woman who's run the place for over twenty years and started remembering my name after a few months. Overall, it's become a sort of second living room for me, and I honestly can't imagine my weekends without it.

checklist: Câu mở có paraphrase đề bài (không lặp từ chính của đề)
Không dùng "I want to talk about"
Câu mở có mệnh đề quan hệ với which / who

Mở đầu bằng "My topic today is…"

rubric.sampleAnswer: The photograph I'd like to describe is one that has been on my desk for years, which is a picture of my grandmother in her garden. It was taken about ten years ago, on a bright winter morning, and my uncle took it without her noticing — she's half-laughing at something off-camera. What I like most about it is that it captures her exactly as I remember her, rather than the posed way people usually appear in family photos. Overall, it's a small, ordinary picture, but it's the one possession I would genuinely be upset to lose.

exercises.title: NHÓM PEOPLE — nguyên tắc

Có phần nói về ảnh hưởng lên bản thân

Mrs Hoa is a retired teacher now and had been teaching for over thirty years when I met her.
She made me believe I could actually do maths, and I've approached difficult subjects differently ever since.
answer: I'd like to talk about my old maths teacher, Mrs Hoa, who taught me in high school.
Mrs Hoa is a retired teacher now and had been teaching for over thirty years when I met her.
One of her most outstanding qualities is her patience — I remember failing a test and expecting a lecture; instead she sat with me for an hour.

exercises.title: Nói: mô tả một người (nhóm PEOPLE)
exercises.instruction: 45 giây chuẩn bị, ghi âm nói 75–100 giây theo template PEOPLE. Mỗi tính từ phải có bằng chứng; có phần ảnh hưởng lên bản thân.

items.prompt: Describe a friend who is important to you. You should say: who this person is · how long you have known them · what they are like. And explain why this person is important to you.

targetStructures: I'd like to talk about…, who…
One of their most outstanding qualities is… For example,…
This person inspires me because… → Overall,…
checklist: Dùng được ít nhất 2 cụm ★ (charismatic, down-to-earth, genuine kindness, resilient…)
Mỗi tính từ đều có một câu bằng chứng cụ thể
Có ít nhất một giai thoại cụ thể (thời gian / nơi chốn / hành động)
Có phần nói về ảnh hưởng lên bản thân
Nói đủ 75 giây, nhắc lại tên nhân vật ít nhất 2 lần
commonErrors: Liệt kê tính từ mà không chứng minh
Chỉ mô tả ngoại hình (tall, thin, long hair)
Nói về người nổi tiếng mà không có kết nối cá nhân
Dùng "he/she" suốt 2 phút, không nhắc lại tên
rubric.sampleAnswer: The person I'd like to describe is my old maths teacher, Mrs Hoa — someone whose influence I only really understood years after I left her class. What stood out was her genuine kindness: she had this habit of never showing surprise, no matter how basic your question was. I remember failing a test in Year 11 and expecting a lecture; instead she sat with me for an hour and worked through it as if we had all the time in the world. Looking back, Mrs Hoa left a lasting impression not because she was a brilliant mathematician, but because she was unshakeably patient — and that patience is genuinely the reason I stopped being afraid of subjects I found hard.

exercises.title: Nói: mô tả một nơi (nhóm PLACES)
exercises.instruction: 45 giây chuẩn bị, ghi âm nói 75–100 giây theo template PLACES. Có ≥1 chi tiết giác quan, một lý do cá nhân, KHÔNG dùng "beautiful" hay "nice".

items.prompt: Describe a natural place you have visited. You should say: where it is · what it looks like · what you did there. And explain how you felt when you were there.

targetStructures: …, which is located in… / on… / at…
The moment I stepped… I was… · What really stands out is…
I chose this place because… → Overall,…
checklist: Đúng 4 lớp: Location → Atmosphere → Facilities → Opinion
Có ít nhất 1 chi tiết giác quan (âm thanh / mùi / ánh sáng)
Không dùng từ "beautiful" hay "nice"
Có lý do CÁ NHÂN, không chỉ mô tả khách quan
Dùng được ít nhất 2 cụm ★
commonErrors: Đọc như bài giới thiệu du lịch, không có trải nghiệm cá nhân
Chỉ nói vị trí địa lý suốt 40 giây
Lặp "beautiful" 5 lần
Không trả lời được "why is it special TO YOU"
rubric.sampleAnswer: I'd like to talk about Da Nang, roughly halfway between Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City. The moment I stepped onto My Khe Beach and felt the sea breeze, I was completely blown away — the water was crystal clear and the whole atmosphere was incredibly refreshing after months of fast-paced urban life. What really stands out, though, is the contrast: you can spend the morning on a pristine beach and be in a mountain resort thirty minutes later. I've been back twice since that first visit and I still find something new each time, which is why it's the one place I keep recommending to friends.

exercises.title: Nói: mô tả một đồ vật (nhóm OBJECTS)
exercises.instruction: 45 giây chuẩn bị, ghi âm nói 75–100 giây. Mô tả hình dáng ≤20 giây; có mốc thời gian (for/since) và một câu chuyện hoặc kỷ niệm cụ thể.

items.prompt: Describe something you own that is important to you. You should say: what it is · how you got it · how long you have had it. And explain why it is important to you.

targetStructures: …that has been in my family for… / I have had it since…
…and he/she said, '…' (câu trích trực tiếp)
It's not just a…, it's a… → Overall,…
checklist: Mô tả hình dáng không quá 20 giây
Có mốc thời gian rõ ràng (for / since)
Có một câu chuyện hoặc kỷ niệm cụ thể gắn với vật
Dùng được ít nhất 2 cụm ★ (sentimental value, keepsake, heirloom…)
Gọi đúng tên vật, không nói "this thing"
commonErrors: Mô tả hình dáng suốt 60 giây rồi hết ý
Trật tự tính từ sai: a wooden old small box
Chọn đồ vật không có kỷ niệm
Dùng "thing" liên tục
rubric.sampleAnswer: I'd like to talk about an old Canon film camera that's been in my family for over thirty years. It's compact by today's standards, with a few small scratches that tell the story of all the places it's been. My father bought it in the late eighties, and when I was about ten he handed it to me and said, 'Technology changes, but a good photograph lasts forever.' That was the moment I fell in love with photography. I still take it out on special occasions, because having a limited number of shots makes you think more carefully about every picture. Overall, it's not just a camera — it's a piece of our family story, and I hope to pass it on to my own children one day.

exercises.title: EVENTS I — khung kể chuyện 6 bước
exercises.instruction: Chọn đáp án đúng.

items.prompt: Khung kể chuyện 6 bước là:

options.text: Intro → Background → Key moment → Resolution → Reflection → Conclusion
Opinion → Reason → Example → Conclusion → Wish → Goodbye
Who → What → When → Where → Why → How
Cause → Effect → Solution → Result → Limit → Kết

items.explanation: Phần Key moment chiếm nhiều thời gian nhất (30–40 giây).

items.prompt: Lỗi cấu trúc nào làm hỏng bài kể?

options.text: Dành 60s cho BACKGROUND rồi chỉ còn 20s cho KEY MOMENT
Có câu báo hiệu cao trào
Rút ra bài học ở phần Reflection
Dùng past simple cho hành động chính

items.explanation: Ngược tỉ lệ hoàn toàn — Key moment phải dài nhất.

items.prompt: Cấu trúc vàng cho bước Key moment:

options.text: I was [V-ing] when suddenly [S + V-ed]

It is [adj] that…

items.explanation: Past continuous = nền; past simple = biến cố cắt ngang.

exercises.title: Sửa lỗi past simple / past continuous
exercises.instruction: Viết lại cả câu cho đúng, chú ý thì.

items.prompt: I walk through the market when someone calls my name.

exercises.title: Nói: kể một sự việc (nhóm EVENTS)
exercises.instruction: 45 giây chuẩn bị, ghi âm nói 90–110 giây theo khung 6 bước. Phần Key moment phải dài nhất; không lẫn thì hiện tại; có phần Reflection.

items.prompt: Describe a time when you helped someone. You should say: when it happened · who you helped · what you did. And explain how you felt afterwards.

targetStructures: It all started when… / I'd like to tell you about a time when…
I was [V-ing] when suddenly [S + V-ed]
In the end,… → Looking back,…
checklist: Có đủ 6 bước: Intro → Background → Key moment → Resolution → Reflection → Conclusion
Phần Key moment dài nhất (ít nhất 30 giây)
Không lẫn thì hiện tại — kể nhất quán ở quá khứ
Dùng được ít nhất 2 cụm ★ (it all started when, it dawned on me, to make matters worse…)
Có phần Reflection rút ra bài học
commonErrors: Kể theo thứ tự thời gian đều đều, không có cao trào
Dùng present simple để kể chuyện quá khứ
Bỏ qua phần Reflection
Kể quá nhiều nhân vật, giám khảo không theo kịp
rubric.sampleAnswer: It all started when my friend and I decided to walk back to our hotel in Hanoi instead of taking a taxi. At the time we were both quite confident we knew the way. We'd been wandering for about forty minutes when it dawned on me that we had passed the same yellow shopfront three times — and to make matters worse, my phone battery died right at that moment. The key moment came when an elderly woman at a tea stall noticed us arguing over a paper map, laughed, and simply started walking, expecting us to follow. She led us the whole way and refused to take anything. Looking back, being lost turned out to be the only reason I have that memory at all — I still think about her kindness whenever people say strangers in big cities don't help each other.

I discovered I had a natural flair for it at fifteen, picking up basic chords from YouTube. exercises.title: Nói: chèn một micro-story vào bài
exercises.instruction: 45 giây chuẩn bị, ghi âm nói 90 giây. Trong bài phải có MỘT micro-story dài 20–30 giây (đủ SETUP – BIẾN CỐ – PHẢN ỨNG), ít nhất 1 cấu trúc so… that / such a… that, và một lần đổi tốc độ ở câu biến cố.

items.prompt: Describe a person who taught you something important. You should say: who they are · what they taught you · when this happened. And explain why it was important.

targetStructures: There was this one time when… → and then, out of nowhere,… → I just stood there…
so + adj + that / such a + adj + noun + that
…, which is exactly why I still think about it
checklist: Có một micro-story dài 20–30 giây
Micro-story có đủ SETUP – BIẾN CỐ – PHẢN ỨNG
Có ít nhất 1 cấu trúc so… that hoặc such a… that
Có thay đổi tốc độ (chậm lại 30%) ở câu biến cố
Nói đủ 90 giây, micro-story liên quan đến ý đang nói
commonErrors: Kể micro-story dài 60 giây → lệch trọng tâm cue card
Micro-story không liên quan đến ý đang nói
Nói cả bài với một tốc độ duy nhất
Dùng so… that sai: "It was so a good film that…"
rubric.sampleAnswer: The person I'd like to talk about is my grandfather, who taught me patience without ever using the word. He was so calm that watching him repair things felt almost meditative. There was this one time, when I was about nine, when I broke a small clock he'd kept for decades. I expected him to be furious. Instead — and I still remember this clearly — he sat down, spread the pieces on the table, and quietly asked me to help him put it back together. It took the whole afternoon. I just sat there, half-terrified, handing him parts. Looking back, that afternoon taught me more about how to respond to mistakes than anything anyone ever said to me, which is exactly why I still think about it whenever something goes wrong.

exercises.instruction: Nối mỗi kỹ thuật với câu mở đầu và việc nó làm.

exercises.instruction: Kéo mỗi câu (mở rộng từ "The sunset was beautiful") vào đúng kỹ thuật.

items.text: To give you an idea, the colours ranged from deep orange to pale violet, and for about five minutes the whole sky looked like it was on fire.
Compared to the sunsets I'd seen in the city, where buildings cut everything off, this was completely uninterrupted from one side to the other.
If I could go back, I'd definitely stay another night just to see whether it happens every evening.
Since that trip, I've started making a point of getting up for sunrise whenever I travel.

exercises.title: Nói: nói đủ 120 giây bằng 4 kỹ thuật
exercises.instruction: 60 giây chuẩn bị, ghi âm nói ĐỦ 120 giây, không dừng quá 3 giây. Dùng ít nhất 3 trong 4 kỹ thuật ZOOM IN / COMPARE / IMAGINE / IMPACT. Không lặp lại ý.

items.prompt: Describe a day out that you enjoyed. You should say: where you went · who you went with · what you did. And explain why you enjoyed it.

targetStructures: To give you an idea,… (ZOOM IN)
Compared to… (COMPARE) · If I could go back, I'd… (IMAGINE)
Since then, I've started to… (IMPACT)
checklist: Nói đủ 120 giây
Dùng ít nhất 3 trong 4 kỹ thuật (ZOOM IN / COMPARE / IMAGINE / IMPACT)
Không dừng quá 3 giây lần nào
Không lặp lại ý đã nói
Có câu kết đàng hoàng nếu chưa bị dừng
commonErrors: Lặp lại ý cũ bằng từ khác để câu giờ
Im lặng 4–5 giây rồi mới tìm ý mới
Nói nhanh hơn để "lấp" thời gian
Kết bài ở giây thứ 70 rồi ngồi im
rubric.sampleAnswer: I'd like to talk about a trip to Da Lat with my family last summer. To give you an idea, the weather was surprisingly cold for Vietnam — around fifteen degrees at night — and we spent the first evening at the night market, mostly eating grilled meat off a charcoal grill with plastic stools. Compared to Ho Chi Minh City, where you eat surrounded by traffic noise, sitting outdoors in that cool air felt like a completely different country. The next day we visited a flower garden and a lake, and honestly the highlight was just the slower pace. If I could go back, I'd stay in one of the small guesthouses outside town rather than a hotel in the centre, because the parts I remember most were the quiet ones. Since that trip, I've actually started planning holidays around cooler places, which is something I would never have considered before. Overall, it wasn't a dramatic trip, but it changed how I think about where I want to spend my free time.

exercises.title: Nói: một cue card hoàn toàn xa lạ
exercises.instruction: 45 giây chuẩn bị, ghi âm nói 90–110 giây. Bắt đầu nói trong 3 giây, KHÔNG phân trần. Dùng ít nhất 1 mẫu IMAGINE / trải nghiệm vay mượn và 1 câu điều kiện loại 2 đúng.

items.prompt: Describe a sound you find pleasant. You should say: what the sound is · where and when you usually hear it · how it makes you feel. And explain why you find it pleasant.

targetStructures: That's an interesting one — the first thing that comes to mind is…
Although I haven't … personally, … / A friend of mine once told me…
If I had the chance, I imagine it would feel…
checklist: Bắt đầu nói trong vòng 3 giây sau khi hết giờ chuẩn bị
Không phân trần về việc chưa có trải nghiệm
Dùng ít nhất 1 mẫu IMAGINE hoặc trải nghiệm vay mượn
Có ít nhất 1 câu điều kiện loại 2 đúng
Nói đủ 90 giây, không im quá 3 giây
commonErrors: Nói "I have never done this, sorry" rồi dừng
Bịa một trải nghiệm chi tiết rồi tự mâu thuẫn
Dùng câu điều kiện sai: "If I would have the chance…"
Mất 20 giây đầu để phân trần
rubric.sampleAnswer: That's an interesting one — the first thing that comes to mind is the sound of rain on a metal roof. I mainly associate it with my grandmother's house in the countryside, where the roof was corrugated iron, and in the rainy season the sound would build from a light tapping to something almost deafening. It's oddly calming — it makes the house feel very safe and closed off from everything outside. I've read that this kind of steady, low-frequency noise helps people sleep, and I can believe it, because I've never fallen asleep faster than during those storms. If I had the chance, I'd love to record it properly one day and play it back in the city, though I suspect it wouldn't feel the same without the actual house around it. Overall, it's a small, ordinary sound, but it's tied to a place and a person I don't get to visit often enough.

exercises.title: THI THỬ — Test A (Người có ảnh hưởng)
exercises.instruction: Điều kiện thi: 1 phút chuẩn bị, KHÔNG dừng để hỏi từ vựng. Ghi âm trả lời cue card rồi trả lời tiếp 2 câu hỏi phụ. AI chấm theo 4 tiêu chí.

items.prompt: CUE CARD — Describe a person who has had an important influence on your life. You should say: who this person is · how you know them · what they have done. And explain why they have influenced you.
Follow-up 1 — Do you think people are influenced more by family or by friends?
Follow-up 2 — Is it important to have role models when you are young?

targetStructures: Template PEOPLE 5 phần
One of their most outstanding qualities is… For example,…
This person inspires me because… → Overall,…
checklist: Bắt đầu nói trong 3 giây; câu mở paraphrase đề bài
Có đủ 4 phần của khung bài nói, nói được ít nhất 100 giây
Có ít nhất 1 micro-story hoặc giai thoại cụ thể; mỗi tính từ có bằng chứng
Dùng ít nhất 3 collocation đã học; không im quá 3 giây
Có câu kết rõ ràng; trả lời được 2 câu hỏi phụ
commonErrors: Dừng giữa chừng để hỏi từ vựng
Trả lời 4 gạch đầu dòng rồi hết
Nhìn giấy ghi chú liên tục
Bỏ câu kết vì mệt
rubric.sampleAnswer: Tham khảo bài mẫu Band 7 ở Buổi 4 (PEOPLE) và Buổi 12 (chèn micro-story): mở bằng "The person I'd like to describe is…, who…", nêu MỘT phẩm chất kèm một giai thoại 20–30 giây, một câu về ảnh hưởng thật lên bạn, rồi "Overall,…". Hai câu hỏi phụ trả lời ngắn 20–30 giây, có sắc thái ("It depends on…" / "On balance,…").

exercises.title: THI THỬ — Test B (Việc không như dự tính)
exercises.instruction: 1 phút chuẩn bị, ghi âm trả lời cue card rồi 2 câu hỏi phụ, không dừng giữa chừng. AI chấm theo 4 tiêu chí.

items.prompt: CUE CARD — Describe an occasion when something did not go as planned. You should say: when it happened · what you had planned · what actually happened. And explain how you dealt with the situation.
Follow-up 1 — Do you think it is better to plan everything or to be flexible?
Follow-up 2 — How do people in your country usually react when plans change?

targetStructures: Khung kể chuyện 6 bước
I was [V-ing] when suddenly [S + V-ed] · By the time…, I had already…
In the end,… → Looking back,…
checklist: Bắt đầu nói trong 3 giây; đủ 6 bước kể chuyện
Phần Key moment dài nhất; thì quá khứ nhất quán
Có ít nhất 1 câu past perfect; ≥3 collocation đã học
Có phần Reflection; câu kết rõ ràng; ≥100 giây
Trả lời được 2 câu hỏi phụ
commonErrors: Kể đều đều không có cao trào
Lẫn thì hiện tại giữa chừng
Bỏ qua phần Reflection
Trả lời câu phụ chỉ một câu rồi im
rubric.sampleAnswer: Tham khảo bài mẫu Band 7 ở Buổi 7 và 8 (EVENTS): "It all started when…", nền bằng past continuous, biến cố bằng past simple, một câu past perfect ở phần Background, phần Key moment dài nhất, rồi "In the end,… Looking back,…". Câu phụ về "plan vs flexible" trả lời hai chiều có chốt: "On balance, I'd say a loose plan works best — enough structure to feel prepared, enough flexibility to adapt."

exercises.title: THI THỬ — Test C (Nơi giới thiệu cho khách)
exercises.instruction: 1 phút chuẩn bị, ghi âm trả lời cue card rồi 2 câu hỏi phụ, không dừng giữa chừng. AI chấm theo 4 tiêu chí.

items.prompt: CUE CARD — Describe a place you would recommend to a visitor to your country. You should say: where it is · what people can do there · who you would recommend it to. And explain why you would recommend it.
Follow-up 1 — Has tourism changed your country in recent years?
Follow-up 2 — Do you think tourists should learn about local culture before travelling?

targetStructures: Template PLACES 5 phần
The moment I… I was… · What really stands out is…
I'd recommend it to anyone who… → Overall,…
checklist: Bắt đầu nói trong 3 giây; đủ 4 lớp Location → Atmosphere → Facilities → Opinion
Có ít nhất 1 chi tiết giác quan; không dùng "beautiful"/"nice"
Có lý do CÁ NHÂN, không chỉ mô tả khách quan; ≥3 collocation
Câu kết rõ ràng; ≥100 giây; không im quá 3 giây
Trả lời được 2 câu hỏi phụ
commonErrors: Đọc như bài giới thiệu du lịch, không có trải nghiệm cá nhân
Chỉ nói vị trí địa lý suốt 40 giây
Lặp "beautiful"
Trả lời câu phụ về tourism một chiều, không chốt
rubric.sampleAnswer: Tham khảo bài mẫu Band 7 ở Buổi 5 (PLACES): "I'd like to talk about…, which is located in…", một câu FIRST IMPRESSION có giác quan, "What really stands out is…", một chi tiết cá nhân ("I've been back twice since…"), rồi "Overall,… I'd recommend it to anyone who…". Câu phụ về tourism trả lời theo Buổi 13 Part 3 (Adv/Disadv): nêu ai hưởng lợi, ai chịu thiệt, chốt bằng "provided that…".
